feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 8:24am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 04 June 2026 at 8:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure over Scotland will move slowly northwards.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 5 or 6, occasionally 7 in east of the area at first, then slowly decreasing West 4 or 5 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming generally moderate later today, then slight or moderate later tonight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, then showers later today, fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 4 or 5, backing Southwest later tomorrow morning, then South later in the day,, occasionally 6 in the west of the area. Backing generally Southeast 5 to 7 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain spreading from the south at night and into Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Generally good, occasionally moderate later.
